note: Four wooded campgrounds near Cameron, south of small Lake Allaman. Campgrounds 1 and 2 stay open all year; 3 and 4 close November to mid-April. The booking site lists every basic pad at 20 ft; the electric pads run 38-99 ft. Park gates close at 9 p.m. in season and at sunset off-season. --Claude
summary: Confirmed $14-15 basic base, electric +12 (2027), 50A, not waterfront; added military $2, showers/flush/vault/dump/water, 19 pull-throughs, max 99 ft; site count 85 -> 81 (booking grid). No split (all four within ~450 m). Season and booking (manual) not touched; season note is missing the Campgrounds 3-4 closure (flag). Pin ~900 m off at the north boundary road (flag). Basic pads all listed at 20 ft (flag).
flags: FIT / BASE: UseDirect lists EVERY basic pad (Campground 1's 30 and Campground 3's 5, pull-throughs included) at 'Pad Length 20'. The identical value on 35 sites, pull-throughs included, reads like a default rather than a measurement, and the photos (006, 012, 020, 023, 027, 034, 065) show ordinary wooded gravel and paved spurs, so the basic $14-15 base is kept with this caveat. If the 20 ft is real, a 23-ft rig fits no basic site and the base becomes electric 30A $23 / $27. The electric sites (38-99 ft; 048 also 20) fit easily, so the entry stays in either case.

SEASON (manual, not touched): stored year_round + 'Showers and water Apr 15-Oct 31.' is right for Campgrounds 1 and 2, but the note leaves out that Campgrounds 3 and 4 are open only Apr 15-Oct 31 ('3 and 4 ... Apr 15-Oct. 31'; 'Campgrounds 3 and 4 are closed during the off-season'). Suggested season.note: 'Campgrounds 1 and 2 year-round; Campgrounds 3 and 4 Apr 15-Oct 31. Showers and water Apr 15-Oct 31.'

BOOKING (manual, not touched): stored reservable + weekend 2-night minimum matches the page. The page also states: 12-month window, walk-up if not reserved (fcfs after_cutoff), 15 days in any 30 (max 15), and Reservations 'Apr 15-Oct 31' for all four campgrounds (booking.season Apr 15-Oct 31).

WATERFRONT not waterfront confirmed: on leaf-off imagery the nearest sites (Campground 1, 16-18) are ~140 m through woods from the east tip of Lake Allaman (a small fishing lake); no site has a view. The park page currently carries a harmful-algae advisory for Lake Allaman.
SPLIT: no. The four campgrounds sit within ~450 m of each other along one park road (39.6519-39.6569, -94.2132 to -94.2108).
PIN OFF ~900 m: stored 39.6620,-94.2160 sits on the park's north boundary road. Corrected coords: 39.6544,-94.2120 (between Campgrounds 1 and 2; UseDirect facility 837 is at 39.6560,-94.2117).
